commits.message:
chore: update spell check dictionary

Add MCP-related terms (modelcontextprotocol, nuxtjs) to VS Code spell checker dictionary.

feat: integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) server

- Add @nuxtjs/mcp-toolkit module and zod dependency
- Configure MCP server with project name and version
- Implement MCP resources for blog content access
- Add commit prompt following Conventional Commits specification
- Include Conventional Commits documentation as MCP resource

This enables AI agents to interact with the project through standardized MCP protocol, providing access to blog content and commit workflow automation.

refactor(content): migrate about page from YAML to Markdown format

- Convert content/about.yml to content/about.md for better content management
- Update content.config.ts to use Markdown source for about collection
- Replace MDC component with ContentRenderer in about.vue page
- Remove unused speaking collection from content configuration

chore: simplify pnpm workspace hoisting configuration

Replace publicHoistPattern with shamefullyHoist for simpler dependency management

refactor: remove demo content and personalize site

- Remove sample blog posts, projects, and speaking page
- Delete Testimonials component and simplify Hero component
- Update personal information in content files
- Replace hero images with personal avatar
- Clean up app configuration and dependencies

chore: add tailwindcss to publicHoistPattern in pnpm workspace

Configure tailwindcss to be hoisted publicly for better accessibility in workspace

chore: remove redundant config files

- remove .editorconfig (formatting now handled by ESLint)
- remove .npmrc (shamefully-hoist no longer needed)

chore: add husky and lint-staged for pre-commit linting

- add husky for git hooks management
- add lint-staged to run eslint on staged files
- configure pre-commit hook to auto-fix code before commit
- add custom words to VSCode spell checker (iconify, vueuse)

chore: integrate @antfu/eslint-config and format codebase

- add @antfu/eslint-config as dev dependency
- configure VSCode settings for ESLint auto-fix
- update eslint.config.mjs to use antfu's config
- simplify nuxt.config.ts eslint settings
- format all source files with new ESLint rules (trailing commas, spacing)
- adjust package.json field order

refactor: adjust packageManager field position in package.json

Move packageManager field to the top of package.json after type field for better organization

feat: initialize Nuxt portfolio website with UI template

- setup Nuxt 4 with TypeScript and ESLint configuration
- add core components (Header, Footer, ColorMode, Polaroid)
- add landing page sections (Hero, About, Blog, FAQ, Testimonials, WorkExperience)
- add pages (index, about, projects, speaking, blog)
- add content management with sample blog posts and projects
- configure CI/CD workflow with GitHub Actions
- add Renovate for automated dependency updates
- include project documentation and license (MIT)
